locations.note: JC Denton's first mission: UNATCO's headquarters under the Statue of Liberty, with the NSF holding the island above it.
JC's New York missions in a decaying 2052 city: Battery Park, Hell's Kitchen and the airfield at LaGuardia, until he turns against UNATCO.
JC flees to Hong Kong, where the Triads and the hacker Tracer Tong help him dig into the conspiracy.
JC's Hong Kong is the Wan Chai market, the Luminous Path compound and the Versalife tower above it.
In Paris JC finds the Silhouette resistance and meets Morgan Everett, the Illuminati's leader.
JC crosses the Paris catacombs to reach the Silhouette resistance.
JC defends Vandenberg against Walton Simons's assault, where Majestic 12 defectors hide with a second universal constructor.
The finale at Area 51, where Bob Page is merging with the AI Helios and JC chooses how the world ends.

routes.name: JC Denton
routes.note: From UNATCO on Liberty Island to the end at Area 51.
